C:\laragon\www\sales-accounting>php diagnose_purchase_duplicate.php > diagnosis_result.txt

C:\laragon\www\sales-accounting>php diagnose_purchase_duplicate.php

Parse error: syntax error, unexpected token "??", expecting "->" or "?->" or "{" or "[" in C:\laragon\www\sales-accounting\diagnose_purchase_duplicate.php on line 123

C:\laragon\www\sales-accou<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\InvoiceItem;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\Warehouse;
use Exception;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class InvoiceService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected StockService $stock
    ) {}

    public function createSale(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $customer = Customer::lockForUpdate()->find($data['customer_id']);

            if (!$customer) {
                throw new Exception('العميل غير موجود.');
            }

            $warehouse = Warehouse::lockForUpdate()->find($data['warehouse_id']);

            if (!$warehouse) {
                throw new Exception('المخزن غير موجود.');
            }

            $invoice = Invoice::create([
                'invoice_no' => $this->generateInvoiceNumber('sale'),
                'type' => 'sale',
                'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                'supplier_id' => null,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => $data['due_date'] ?? null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            $itemsSubtotal = 0;
            $itemsDiscount = 0;
            $taxTotal = 0;
            $grandTotal = 0;

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                $product = Product::lockForUpdate()->find($item['product_id']);

                if (!$product) {
                    throw new Exception('أحد الأصناف غير موجود.');
                }

                $quantity = (float) ($item['quantity'] ?? 0);

                if ($quantity <= 0) {
                    throw new Exception('الكمية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر.');
                }

                $price = (float) ($item['price'] ?? 0);
                $discount = (float) ($item['discount'] ?? 0);

                $lineSubtotal = $quantity * $price;

                if ($discount > $lineSubtotal) {
                    $discount = $lineSubtotal;
                }

                $net = $lineSubtotal - $discount;
                $taxAmount = $net * ((float) $product->tax_rate) / 100;
                $lineTotal = $net + $taxAmount;

                $itemsSubtotal += $lineSubtotal;
                $itemsDiscount += $discount;
                $taxTotal += $taxAmount;
                $grandTotal += $lineTotal;

                InvoiceItem::create([
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'quantity' => $quantity,
                    'price' => $price,
                    'discount' => $discount,
                    'tax' => $taxAmount,
                    'total' => $lineTotal,
                    'cost_price' => $product->cost_price,
                ]);

                $this->stock->decrease(
                    $product->id,
                    $warehouse->id,
                    $quantity,
                    'sale',
                    $invoice,
                    'فاتورة بيع رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no
                );
            }

            $paidAmount = min((float) ($data['paid_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);
            $remainingAmount = $grandTotal - $paidAmount;

            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $itemsSubtotal,
                'discount' => $itemsDiscount,
                'tax' => $taxTotal,
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => $paidAmount,
                'remaining_amount' => $remainingAmount,
            ]);

            $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance + $grandTotal;

            if ($paidAmount > 0) {
                Payment::create([
                    'payment_no' => $this->generatePaymentNumber('receipt'),
                    'type' => 'receipt',
                    'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                    'supplier_id' => null,
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'amount' => $paidAmount,
                    'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                    'payment_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                    'notes' => 'دفعة على فاتورة بيع رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no,
                    'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                ]);

                $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance - $paidAmount;
            }

            $customer->save();

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'customer']);
        });
    }

    public function createPurchase(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $supplier = Supplier::lockForUpdate()->find($data['supplier_id']);

            if (!$supplier) {
                throw new Exception('المورد غير موجود.');
            }

            $warehouse = Warehouse::lockForUpdate()->find($data['warehouse_id']);

            if (!$warehouse) {
                throw new Exception('المخزن غير موجود.');
            }

            $invoice = Invoice::create([
                'invoice_no' => $this->generateInvoiceNumber('purchase'),
                'type' => 'purchase',
                'customer_id' => null,
                'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => $data['due_date'] ?? null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            $itemsSubtotal = 0;
            $itemsDiscount = 0;
            $taxTotal = 0;
            $grandTotal = 0;

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                $product = Product::lockForUpdate()->find($item['product_id']);

                if (!$product) {
                    throw new Exception('أحد الأصناف غير موجود.');
                }

                $quantity = (float) ($item['quantity'] ?? 0);

                if ($quantity <= 0) {
                    throw new Exception('الكمية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر.');
                }

                $price = (float) ($item['price'] ?? 0);
                $discount = (float) ($item['discount'] ?? 0);

                $lineSubtotal = $quantity * $price;

                if ($discount > $lineSubtotal) {
                    $discount = $lineSubtotal;
                }

                $net = $lineSubtotal - $discount;
                $taxAmount = $net * ((float) $product->tax_rate) / 100;
                $lineTotal = $net + $taxAmount;

                $unitNetCost = $quantity > 0 ? $net / $quantity : 0;

                $itemsSubtotal += $lineSubtotal;
                $itemsDiscount += $discount;
                $taxTotal += $taxAmount;
                $grandTotal += $lineTotal;

                InvoiceItem::create([
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'quantity' => $quantity,
                    'price' => $price,
                    'discount' => $discount,
                    'tax' => $taxAmount,
                    'total' => $lineTotal,
                    'cost_price' => $unitNetCost,
                ]);

                $product->cost_price = $unitNetCost;
                $product->save();

                $this->stock->increase(
                    $product->id,
                    $warehouse->id,
                    $quantity,
                    'purchase',
                    $invoice,
                    'فاتورة شراء رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no
                );
            }

            $paidAmount = min((float) ($data['paid_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);
            $remainingAmount = $grandTotal - $paidAmount;

            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $itemsSubtotal,
                'discount' => $itemsDiscount,
                'tax' => $taxTotal,
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => $paidAmount,
                'remaining_amount' => $remainingAmount,
            ]);

            $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance + $grandTotal;

            if ($paidAmount > 0) {
                Payment::create([
                    'payment_no' => $this->generatePaymentNumber('payment'),
                    'type' => 'payment',
                    'customer_id' => null,
                    'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'amount' => $paidAmount,
                    'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                    'payment_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                    'notes' => 'دفعة على فاتورة شراء رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no,
                    'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                ]);

                $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance - $paidAmount;
            }

            $supplier->save();

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'supplier']);
        });
    }

    public function createSaleReturn(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $customer = Customer::lockForUpdate()->find($data['customer_id']);

            if (!$customer) {
                throw new Exception('العميل غير موجود.');
            }

            $warehouse = Warehouse::lockForUpdate()->find($data['warehouse_id']);

            if (!$warehouse) {
                throw new Exception('المخزن غير موجود.');
            }

            $invoice = Invoice::create([
                'invoice_no' => $this->generateInvoiceNumber('sale_return'),
                'type' => 'sale_return',
                'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                'supplier_id' => null,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            $itemsSubtotal = 0;
            $itemsDiscount = 0;
            $taxTotal = 0;
            $grandTotal = 0;

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                $product = Product::lockForUpdate()->find($item['product_id']);

                if (!$product) {
                    throw new Exception('أحد الأصناف غير موجود.');
                }

                $quantity = (float) ($item['quantity'] ?? 0);

                if ($quantity <= 0) {
                    throw new Exception('الكمية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر.');
                }

                $price = (float) ($item['price'] ?? 0);
                $discount = (float) ($item['discount'] ?? 0);

                $lineSubtotal = $quantity * $price;

                if ($discount > $lineSubtotal) {
                    $discount = $lineSubtotal;
                }

                $net = $lineSubtotal - $discount;
                $taxAmount = $net * ((float) $product->tax_rate) / 100;
                $lineTotal = $net + $taxAmount;

                $itemsSubtotal += $lineSubtotal;
                $itemsDiscount += $discount;
                $taxTotal += $taxAmount;
                $grandTotal += $lineTotal;

                InvoiceItem::create([
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'quantity' => $quantity,
                    'price' => $price,
                    'discount' => $discount,
                    'tax' => $taxAmount,
                    'total' => $lineTotal,
                    'cost_price' => $product->cost_price,
                ]);

                $this->stock->increase(
                    $product->id,
                    $warehouse->id,
                    $quantity,
                    'sale_return',
                    $invoice,
                    'مرتجع بيع رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no
                );
            }

            $refundAmount = min((float) ($data['refund_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);
            $remainingAmount = $grandTotal - $refundAmount;

            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $itemsSubtotal,
                'discount' => $itemsDiscount,
                'tax' => $taxTotal,
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => $refundAmount,
                'remaining_amount' => $remainingAmount,
            ]);

            // مرتجع البيع يقلل رصيد العميل المستحق
            $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance - $grandTotal;

            // إذا تم رد مبلغ نقدًا أو بأي طريقة، نسجل حركة دفع للعميل
            if ($refundAmount > 0) {
                Payment::create([
                    'payment_no' => $this->generatePaymentNumber('payment'),
                    'type' => 'payment',
                    'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                    'supplier_id' => null,
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'amount' => $refundAmount,
                    'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                    'payment_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                    'notes' => 'مبلغ مسترد على مرتجع بيع رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no,
                    'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                ]);

                $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance + $refundAmount;
            }

            $customer->save();

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'customer']);
        });
    }

    public function createPurchaseReturn(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $supplier = Supplier::lockForUpdate()->find($data['supplier_id']);

            if (!$supplier) {
                throw new Exception('المورد غير موجود.');

                'customer_id' => null,
                'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            $itemsSubtotal = 0;
            $itemsDiscount = 0;
            $taxTotal = 0;
            $grandTotal = 0;

                }

                $discount = (float) ($item['discount'] ?? 0);

                $lineSubtotal = $quantity * $price;

                if ($discount > $lineSubtotal) {
                    $discount = $lineSubtotal;
                }

                $net = $lineSubtotal - $discount;
                $taxAmount = $net * ((float) $product->tax_rate) / 100;
                $lineTotal = $net + $taxAmount;

                $unitNetCost = $quantity > 0 ? $net / $quantity : 0;

                $itemsSubtotal += $lineSubtotal;

                InvoiceItem::create([

                $this->stock->decrease(
                    $product->id,

                    $invoice,
                    'مرتجع شراء رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no
                );
            }

            $refundAmount = min((float) ($data['refund_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);

            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $itemsSubtotal,
                'discount' => $itemsDiscount,
                'tax' => $taxTotal,
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => $refundAmount,
                'remaining_amount' => $remainingAmount,
            ]);

            // مرتجع الشراء يقلل المستحق للمورد
            $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance - $grandTotal;

            // إذا استلمنا مبلغًا من المورد، نسجل سند قبض

            }

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'supplier']);
        });
    }

    private function generateInvoiceNumber(string $type): string
    {
        $prefix = match ($type) {
            'sale' => 'INV',
            'sale_return' => 'SRT',
            'purchase' => 'PUR',
            'purchase_return' => 'PRT',
            default => 'INV',
        };

        $settingKey = match ($type) {
            'sale' => 'invoice_prefix',
            'sale_return' => 'sale_return_prefix',
            'purchase' => 'purchase_prefix',
            'purchase_return' => 'purchase_return_prefix',
            default => 'invoice_prefix',
        };

        $settingPrefix = Setting::where('key', $settingKey)->value('value');

        if ($settingPrefix) {
            $prefix = $settingPrefix;
        }

        $lastId = Invoice::max('id') + 1;

        return $prefix . '-' . now()->format('Ymd') . '-' . str_pad((string) $lastId, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }

    private function generatePaymentNumber(string $type): string
    {
        $prefix = $type === 'receipt' ? 'REC' : 'PAY';

        $settingKey = $type === 'receipt' ? 'payment_receipt_prefix' : 'payment_order_prefix';

        $settingPrefix = Setting::where('key', $settingKey)->value('value');

        if ($settingPrefix) {
            $prefix = $settingPrefix;
        }

        $lastId = Payment::max('id') + 1;

        return $prefix . '-' . now()->format('Ymd') . '-' . str_pad((string) $lastId, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }

    /**
     * تحديد الحساب بناءً على طريقة الدفع
     */
    protected function resolveAccountId(string $paymentMethod): int
    {
        $accountCode = match ($paymentMethod) {
            'cash' => '1001',
            'card', 'insta', 'visa' => '1003',
            'bank_transfer', 'cheque' => '1002',
            default => '1001',
        };
        
        $account = \App\Models\Account::where('code', $accountCode)->first();
        return $account ? $account->id : 1; // افتراضياً الصندوق
    }

    /**
     * الحصول على السعر حسب مستوى العميل
     */
    protected function getPriceForCustomer(Product $product, ?Customer $customer): float
    {
        $level = $customer?->price_level ?? 'retail';
        
        return match ($level) {
            'retail' => (float) $product->sale_price,
            'wholesale' => (float) $product->wholesale_price,
            'factory' => (float) $product->factory_price,
            'cost' => (float) $product->cost_price,
            default => (float) $product->sale_price,
        };
    }

    /**
     * الحصول على اسم مستوى السعر
     */
    protected function getPriceLevelName(string $level): string
    {
        return match ($level) {
            'retail' => 'بيع',
            'wholesale' => 'جملة',
            'factory' => 'مصنع',
            'cost' => 'تكلفة',
            default => 'بيع',
        };
    }

 <?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\JournalEntry;
use App\Services\AccountingService;
use App\Services\NotificationService;
use Throwable;

class InvoiceObserver
{
    public function updated(Invoice $invoice): void
    {
        if (!in_array($invoice->type, ['sale', 'purchase', 'sale_return', 'purchase_return'])) {
            return;
        }

        if (!$invoice->items()->exists()) {
            return;
        }

        if (JournalEntry::where('ref_type', 'invoice')->where('ref_id', $invoice->id)->exists()) {
            return;
        }

        app(AccountingService::class)->postInvoice($invoice);

        try {
            app(NotificationService::class)->notifyInvoice($invoice);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // لا نوقف العملية بسبب خطأ إشعار
        }
    }
} <?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\Warehouse;
use App\Services\InvoiceService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Throwable;

class PurchaseInvoiceController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $invoices = Invoice::where('type', 'purchase')
            ->with('supplier')
            ->orderBy('id', 'desc')
            ->paginate(10);

        return view('purchases.index', compact('invoices'));
    }

    public function create()
    {
        $suppliers = Supplier::where('is_active', true)
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get();

        $warehouses = Warehouse::where('is_active', true)
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get();

        $products = Product::where('is_active', true)
            ->with('stocks')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($product) {
                return [
                    'id' => $product->id,
                    'name' => $product->name,
                    'code' => $product->code,
                    'cost_price' => (float) $product->cost_price,
                    'tax_rate' => (float) $product->tax_rate,
                    'stocks' => $product->stocks
                        ->mapWithKeys(function ($stock) {
                            return [$stock->warehouse_id => (float) $stock->quantity];
                        })
                        ->all(),
                ];
            });

        return view('purchases.create', compact('suppliers', 'warehouses', 'products'));
    }

    public function store(Request $request, InvoiceService $invoiceService)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'supplier_id' => ['required', 'exists:suppliers,id'],
            'warehouse_id' => ['required', 'exists:warehouses,id'],
            'invoice_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'due_date' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:invoice_date'],
            'paid_amount' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'payment_method' => ['required', 'in:cash,card,bank_transfer,cheque,credit'],
            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'items' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            'items.*.product_id' => ['required', 'exists:products,id'],
            'items.*.quantity' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0.001'],
            'items.*.price' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'items.*.discount' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
        ]);

        try {
            $invoice = $invoiceService->createPurchase($validated, $validated['items']);

            return redirect()
                ->route('purchases.show', $invoice)
                ->with('success', 'تم إنشاء فاتورة الشراء بنجاح.');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withInput()
                ->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function show(Invoice $invoice)
    {
        if ($invoice->type !== 'purchase') {
            abort(404);
        }

        $invoice->load(['supplier', 'warehouse', 'items.product', 'payments']);

        return view('purchases.show', compact('invoice'));
    }
} 

### ASSISTANT
# 🎯 وجدت السبب الجذري!

## 🔍 التحليل

بعد مراجعة الـ 3 ملفات، المشكلة واضحة تماماً. **`paid_amount` يُحدَّث في 3 أماكن مختلفة:**

```
المكان 1: InvoiceService::createPurchase()
  → $invoice->update(['paid_amount' => 1000])     ← يضبط 1000 ✅

المكان 2: PaymentObserver::updateInvoicePaidAmount()
  → $invoice->paid_amount += 1000 → أصبح 2000     ← تكرار! ❌

المكان 3: PaymentObserver::updatePartyBalance() يحدّث الرصيد
  + InvoiceService يحدّث الرصيد أيضاً              ← تكرار! ❌
```

**وأيضاً رصيد المورد يُحدَّث مرتين:**
- `InvoiceService`: `$supplier->current_balance -= $paidAmount`
- `PaymentObserver`: `$supplier->current_balance -= $amount`

---

## 🚀 الحل: تنظيف InvoiceService

**المبدأ:** `InvoiceService` ينشئ الفاتورة والسند فقط. `PaymentObserver` يتولى تحديث `paid_amount` والرصيد.

```bash
cd C:\laragon\www\sales-accounting
type nul > fix_triple_payment.php
notepad fix_triple_payment.php
```

```php
$invoiceServiceCode = <<<'PHPCODE'
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\InvoiceItem;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\Warehouse;
use Exception;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class InvoiceService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected StockService $stock
    ) {}

    /**
     * إنشاء فاتورة بيع
     */
    public function createSale(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $customer = Customer::lockForUpdate()->find($data['customer_id']);
            if (!$customer) {
                throw new Exception('العميل غير موجود.');
            }

            $warehouse = Warehouse::lockForUpdate()->find($data['warehouse_id']);
            if (!$warehouse) {
                throw new Exception('المخزن غير موجود.');
            }

            // إنشاء الفاتورة (بدون paid_amount مبدئياً)
            $invoice = Invoice::create([
                'invoice_no' => $this->generateInvoiceNumber('sale'),
                'type' => 'sale',
                'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                'supplier_id' => null,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => $data['due_date'] ?? null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            // حساب الأصناف
            $totals = $this->processInvoiceItems($invoice, $items, $warehouse, 'sale');

            $grandTotal = $totals['grandTotal'];
            $paidAmount = min((float) ($data['paid_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);

            // تحديث إجماليات الفاتورة
            // ⚠️ لا نضع paid_amount هنا - PaymentObserver سيتولى ذلك
            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $totals['subtotal'],
                'discount' => $totals['discount'],
                'tax' => $totals['tax'],
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => $grandTotal,
            ]);

            // تحديث رصيد العميل (الفاتورة فقط - بدون المدفوع)
            // العميل أصبح مدين لنا بقيمة الفاتورة
            $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance + $grandTotal;
            $customer->save();

            // إنشاء سند القبض (إن وجد مبلغ مدفوع)
            // ⚠️ PaymentObserver سيتولى:
            //   1. تحديث invoice.paid_amount
            //   2. تحديث customer.current_balance
            //   3. إنشاء القيد المحاسبي
            if ($paidAmount > 0) {
                Payment::create([
                    'payment_no' => $this->generatePaymentNumber('receipt'),
                    'type' => 'receipt',
                    'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                    'supplier_id' => null,
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'account_id' => $this->resolveAccountId($data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash'),
                    'amount' => $paidAmount,
                    'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                    'payment_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                    'notes' => 'دفعة على فاتورة بيع رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no,
                    'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                ]);
            }

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'customer']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * إنشاء فاتورة شراء
     */
    public function createPurchase(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $supplier = Supplier::lockForUpdate()->find($data['supplier_id']);
            if (!$supplier) {
                throw new Exception('المورد غير موجود.');
            }

            $warehouse = Warehouse::lockForUpdate()->find($data['warehouse_id']);
            if (!$warehouse) {
                throw new Exception('المخزن غير موجود.');
            }

            // إنشاء الفاتورة
            $invoice = Invoice::create([
                'invoice_no' => $this->generateInvoiceNumber('purchase'),
                'type' => 'purchase',
                'customer_id' => null,
                'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => $data['due_date'] ?? null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            // حساب الأصناف
            $totals = $this->processInvoiceItems($invoice, $items, $warehouse, 'purchase');

            $grandTotal = $totals['grandTotal'];
            $paidAmount = min((float) ($data['paid_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);

            // تحديث إجماليات الفاتورة
            // ⚠️ لا نضع paid_amount هنا - PaymentObserver سيتولى ذلك
            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $totals['subtotal'],
                'discount' => $totals['discount'],
                'tax' => $totals['tax'],
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => $grandTotal,
            ]);

            // تحديث رصيد المورد (الفاتورة فقط - بدون المدفوع)
            // نحن أصبحنا مدينين للمورد بقيمة الفاتورة
            $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance + $grandTotal;
            $supplier->save();

            // إنشاء سند الصرف (إن وجد مبلغ مدفوع)
            // ⚠️ PaymentObserver سيتولى:
            //   1. تحديث invoice.paid_amount
            //   2. تحديث supplier.current_balance
            //   3. إنشاء القيد المحاسبي
            if ($paidAmount > 0) {
                Payment::create([
                    'payment_no' => $this->generatePaymentNumber('payment'),
                    'type' => 'payment',
                    'customer_id' => null,
                    'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'account_id' => $this->resolveAccountId($data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash'),
                    'amount' => $paidAmount,
                    'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                    'payment_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                    'notes' => 'دفعة على فاتورة شراء رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no,
                    'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                ]);
            }

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'supplier']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * إنشاء مرتجع بيع
     */
    public function createSaleReturn(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $customer = Customer::lockForUpdate()->find($data['customer_id']);
            if (!$customer) {
                throw new Exception('العميل غير موجود.');
            }

            $warehouse = Warehouse::lockForUpdate()->find($data['warehouse_id']);
            if (!$warehouse) {
                throw new Exception('المخزن غير موجود.');
            }

            $invoice = Invoice::create([
                'invoice_no' => $this->generateInvoiceNumber('sale_return'),
                'type' => 'sale_return',
                'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                'supplier_id' => null,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            $totals = $this->processInvoiceItems($invoice, $items, $warehouse, 'sale_return');

            $grandTotal = $totals['grandTotal'];
            $refundAmount = min((float) ($data['refund_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);

            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $totals['subtotal'],
                'discount' => $totals['discount'],
                'tax' => $totals['tax'],
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => $grandTotal,
            ]);

            // مرتجع البيع يقلل رصيد العميل المستحق
            $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance - $grandTotal;
            $customer->save();

            // إذا تم رد مبلغ نقدًا
            if ($refundAmount > 0) {
                Payment::create([
                    'payment_no' => $this->generatePaymentNumber('payment'),
                    'type' => 'payment',
                    'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                    'supplier_id' => null,
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'account_id' => $this->resolveAccountId($data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash'),
                    'amount' => $refundAmount,
                    'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                    'payment_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                    'notes' => 'مبلغ مسترد على مرتجع بيع رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no,
                    'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                ]);
            }

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'customer']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * إنشاء مرتجع شراء
     */
    public function createPurchaseReturn(array $data, array $items): Invoice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $items) {

            $supplier = Supplier::lockForUpdate()->find($data['supplier_id']);
            if (!$supplier) {
                throw new Exception('المورد غير موجود.');
            }

            $warehouse = Warehouse::lockForUpdate()->find($data['warehouse_id']);
            if (!$warehouse) {
                throw new Exception('المخزن غير موجود.');
            }

            $invoice = Invoice::create([
                'invoice_no' => $this->generateInvoiceNumber('purchase_return'),
                'type' => 'purchase_return',
                'customer_id' => null,
                'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                'warehouse_id' => $warehouse->id,
                'invoice_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                'due_date' => null,
                'subtotal' => 0,
                'discount' => 0,
                'tax' => 0,
                'total' => 0,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => 0,
                'status' => 'posted',
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            ]);

            $totals = $this->processInvoiceItems($invoice, $items, $warehouse, 'purchase_return');

            $grandTotal = $totals['grandTotal'];
            $refundAmount = min((float) ($data['refund_amount'] ?? 0), $grandTotal);

            $invoice->update([
                'subtotal' => $totals['subtotal'],
                'discount' => $totals['discount'],
                'tax' => $totals['tax'],
                'total' => $grandTotal,
                'paid_amount' => 0,
                'remaining_amount' => $grandTotal,
            ]);

            // مرتجع الشراء يقلل المستحق للمورد
            $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance - $grandTotal;
            $supplier->save();

            // إذا استلمنا مبلغًا من المورد
            if ($refundAmount > 0) {
                Payment::create([
                    'payment_no' => $this->generatePaymentNumber('receipt'),
                    'type' => 'receipt',
                    'customer_id' => null,
                    'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                    'account_id' => $this->resolveAccountId($data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash'),
                    'amount' => $refundAmount,
                    'payment_method' => $data['payment_method'] ?? 'cash',
                    'payment_date' => $data['invoice_date'],
                    'notes' => 'مبلغ مستلم على مرتجع شراء رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no,
                    'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                ]);
            }

            return $invoice->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'supplier']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * معالجة أصناف الفاتورة (مشترك بين كل الأنواع)
     */
    protected function processInvoiceItems(Invoice $invoice, array $items, Warehouse $warehouse, string $type): array
    {
        $itemsSubtotal = 0;
        $itemsDiscount = 0;
        $taxTotal = 0;
        $grandTotal = 0;

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $product = Product::lockForUpdate()->find($item['product_id']);

            if (!$product) {
                throw new Exception('أحد الأصناف غير موجود.');
            }

            $quantity = (float) ($item['quantity'] ?? 0);
            if ($quantity <= 0) {
                throw new Exception('الكمية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر.');
            }

            $price = (float) ($item['price'] ?? 0);
            $discount = (float) ($item['discount'] ?? 0);

            $lineSubtotal = $quantity * $price;
            if ($discount > $lineSubtotal) {
                $discount = $lineSubtotal;
            }

            $net = $lineSubtotal - $discount;
            $taxAmount = $net * ((float) ($product->tax_rate ?? 0)) / 100;
            $lineTotal = $net + $taxAmount;
            $unitNetCost = $quantity > 0 ? $net / $quantity : 0;

            $itemsSubtotal += $lineSubtotal;
            $itemsDiscount += $discount;
            $taxTotal += $taxAmount;
            $grandTotal += $lineTotal;

            InvoiceItem::create([
                'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                'product_id' => $product->id,
                'quantity' => $quantity,
                'price' => $price,
                'discount' => $discount,
                'tax' => $taxAmount,
                'total' => $lineTotal,
                'cost_price' => ($type === 'purchase' || $type === 'purchase_return')
                    ? $unitNetCost
                    : $product->cost_price,
            ]);

            // تحديث سعر التكلفة عند الشراء
            if ($type === 'purchase') {
                $product->cost_price = $unitNetCost;
                $product->save();
            }

            // حركة المخزون
            if (in_array($type, ['sale', 'purchase_return'])) {
                $this->stock->decrease(
                    $product->id,
                    $warehouse->id,
                    $quantity,
                    $type,
                    $invoice,
                    ($type === 'sale' ? 'فاتورة بيع' : 'مرتجع شراء') . ' رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no
                );
            } else {
                $this->stock->increase(
                    $product->id,
                    $warehouse->id,
                    $quantity,
                    $type,
                    $invoice,
                    ($type === 'purchase' ? 'فاتورة شراء' : 'مرتجع بيع') . ' رقم ' . $invoice->invoice_no
                );
            }
        }

        return [
            'subtotal' => $itemsSubtotal,
            'discount' => $itemsDiscount,
            'tax' => $taxTotal,
            'grandTotal' => $grandTotal,
        ];
    }

    private function generateInvoiceNumber(string $type): string
    {
        $prefix = match ($type) {
            'sale' => 'INV',
            'sale_return' => 'SRT',
            'purchase' => 'PUR',
            'purchase_return' => 'PRT',
            default => 'INV',
        };

        $settingKey = match ($type) {
            'sale' => 'invoice_prefix',
            'sale_return' => 'sale_return_prefix',
            'purchase' => 'purchase_prefix',
            'purchase_return' => 'purchase_return_prefix',
            default => 'invoice_prefix',
        };

        $settingPrefix = Setting::where('key', $settingKey)->value('value');
        if ($settingPrefix) {
            $prefix = $settingPrefix;
        }

        $lastId = Invoice::max('id') + 1;
        return $prefix . '-' . now()->format('Ymd') . '-' . str_pad((string) $lastId, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }

    private function generatePaymentNumber(string $type): string
    {
        $prefix = $type === 'receipt' ? 'REC' : 'PAY';

        $settingKey = $type === 'receipt' ? 'payment_receipt_prefix' : 'payment_order_prefix';
        $settingPrefix = Setting::where('key', $settingKey)->value('value');
        if ($settingPrefix) {
            $prefix = $settingPrefix;
        }

        $lastId = Payment::max('id') + 1;
        return $prefix . '-' . now()->format('Ymd') . '-' . str_pad((string) $lastId, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }

    protected function resolveAccountId(string $paymentMethod): int
    {
        $accountCode = match ($paymentMethod) {
            'cash' => '1001',
            'card', 'insta', 'visa' => '1003',
            'bank_transfer', 'cheque' => '1002',
            default => '1001',
        };

        $account = \App\Models\Account::where('code', $accountCode)->first();
        return $account ? $account->id : 1;
    }

    protected function getPriceForCustomer(Product $product, ?Customer $customer): float
    {
        $level = $customer->price_level ?? 'retail';

        return match ($level) {
            'retail' => (float) $product->sale_price,
            'wholesale' => (float) $product->wholesale_price,
            'factory' => (float) $product->factory_price,
            'cost' => (float) $product->cost_price,
            default => (float) $product->sale_price,
        };
    }

    protected function getPriceLevelName(string $level): string
    {
        return match ($level) {
            'retail' => 'بيع',
            'wholesale' => 'جملة',
            'factory' => 'مصنع',
            'cost' => 'تكلفة',
            default => 'بيع',
        };
    }
}
PHPCODE;

file_put_contents($base . '/app/Services/InvoiceService.php', $invoiceServiceCode);
echo "✅ InvoiceService (أُزيل التكرار)\n";

// ============================================
// 3. إعادة كتابة PaymentObserver
// ============================================
echo "\n📋 المرحلة 2: إعادة كتابة PaymentObserver...\n";

$paymentObserverCode = <<<'PHPCODE'
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\JournalEntry;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class PaymentObserver
{
    /**
     * بعد إنشاء السند
     *
     * هذا هو المكان الوحيد الذي يُحدّث:
     * 1. paid_amount في الفاتورة
     * 2. رصيد العميل/المورد
     * 3. القيد المحاسبي
     */
    public function created(Payment $payment): void
    {
        try {
            // 1. تحديث paid_amount في الفاتورة المرتبطة
            $this->updateInvoicePaidAmount($payment);

            // 2. تحديث رصيد العميل/المورد
            $this->updatePartyBalance($payment);

            // 3. إنشاء القيد المحاسبي
            $this->postJournalEntry($payment);

            Log::info('PaymentObserver::created', [
                'payment_id' => $payment->id,
                'payment_no' => $payment->payment_no,
                'type' => $payment->type,
                'amount' => $payment->amount,
                'customer_id' => $payment->customer_id,
                'supplier_id' => $payment->supplier_id,
                'invoice_id' => $payment->invoice_id,
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error('PaymentObserver Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), [
                'payment_id' => $payment->id,
                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * بعد حذف السند
     */
    public function deleted(Payment $payment): void
    {
        try {
            // عكس تحديث الفاتورة
            $this->reverseInvoicePaidAmount($payment);

            // عكس تحديث الرصيد
            $this->reversePartyBalance($payment);

            // حذف القيد المحاسبي
            JournalEntry::where('ref_type', 'payment')
                ->where('ref_id', $payment->id)
                ->delete();

            Log::info('PaymentObserver::deleted', [
                'payment_id' => $payment->id,
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error('PaymentObserver Delete Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * تحديث paid_amount في الفاتورة
     */
    protected function updateInvoicePaidAmount(Payment $payment): void
    {
        if (!$payment->invoice_id) {
            return;
        }

        $invoice = Invoice::find($payment->invoice_id);
        if (!$invoice) {
            return;
        }

        $amount = (float) $payment->amount;

        // سند قبض من عميل → فاتورة بيع
        if ($payment->type === 'receipt' && $payment->customer_id && $invoice->type === 'sale') {
            $invoice->paid_amount = (float) $invoice->paid_amount + $amount;
        }
        // سند صرف لمورد → فاتورة شراء
        elseif ($payment->type === 'payment' && $payment->supplier_id && $invoice->type === 'purchase') {
            $invoice->paid_amount = (float) $invoice->paid_amount + $amount;
        }
        // سند صرف لعميل (رد) → مرتجع بيع
        elseif ($payment->type === 'payment' && $payment->customer_id && $invoice->type === 'sale_return') {
            $invoice->paid_amount = (float) $invoice->paid_amount + $amount;
        }
        // سند قبض من مورد (رد) → مرتجع شراء
        elseif ($payment->type === 'receipt' && $payment->supplier_id && $invoice->type === 'purchase_return') {
            $invoice->paid_amount = (float) $invoice->paid_amount + $amount;
        }
        else {
            return;
        }

        $invoice->remaining_amount = max(0, (float) $invoice->total - (float) $invoice->paid_amount);

        // ⚠️ استخدام saveQuietly لمنع InvoiceObserver من التكرار
        $invoice->saveQuietly();

        Log::info("Invoice paid_amount updated", [
            'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
            'invoice_no' => $invoice->invoice_no,
            'new_paid' => $invoice->paid_amount,
            'new_remaining' => $invoice->remaining_amount,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * تحديث رصيد العميل/المورد
     *
     * القاعدة:
     * - receipt + customer = العميل دفع لنا (رصيده ينقص)
     * - payment + customer = ندفع للعميل - رد مستحقات (رصيده يزيد)
     * - payment + supplier = ندفع للمورد (رصيده ينقص)
     * - receipt + supplier = نستلم من المورد - مرتجع (رصيده يزيد)
     */
    protected function updatePartyBalance(Payment $payment): void
    {
        $amount = (float) $payment->amount;
        if ($amount <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        // سند قبض من عميل
        if ($payment->customer_id && $payment->type === 'receipt') {
            $customer = Customer::find($payment->customer_id);
            if ($customer) {
                $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance - $amount;
                $customer->save();
                Log::info("Customer balance: {$customer->name} -= {$amount} = {$customer->current_balance}");
            }
        }
        // سند صرف للعميل (رد مستحقات)
        elseif ($payment->customer_id && $payment->type === 'payment') {
            $customer = Customer::find($payment->customer_id);
            if ($customer) {
                $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance + $amount;
                $customer->save();
                Log::info("Customer balance: {$customer->name} += {$amount} = {$customer->current_balance}");
            }
        }
        // سند صرف للمورد
        elseif ($payment->supplier_id && $payment->type === 'payment') {
            $supplier = Supplier::find($payment->supplier_id);
            if ($supplier) {
                $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance - $amount;
                $supplier->save();
                Log::info("Supplier balance: {$supplier->name} -= {$amount} = {$supplier->current_balance}");
            }
        }
        // سند قبض من المورد
        elseif ($payment->supplier_id && $payment->type === 'receipt') {
            $supplier = Supplier::find($payment->supplier_id);
            if ($supplier) {
                $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance + $amount;
                $supplier->save();
                Log::info("Supplier balance: {$supplier->name} += {$amount} = {$supplier->current_balance}");
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * عكس تحديث الفاتورة عند حذف السند
     */
    protected function reverseInvoicePaidAmount(Payment $payment): void
    {
        if (!$payment->invoice_id) {
            return;
        }

        $invoice = Invoice::find($payment->invoice_id);
        if (!$invoice) {
            return;
        }

        $invoice->paid_amount = max(0, (float) $invoice->paid_amount - (float) $payment->amount);
        $invoice->remaining_amount = (float) $invoice->total - (float) $invoice->paid_amount;
        $invoice->saveQuietly();
    }

    /**
     * عكس تحديث رصيد العميل/المورد
     */
    protected function reversePartyBalance(Payment $payment): void
    {
        $amount = (float) $payment->amount;
        if ($amount <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if ($payment->customer_id && $payment->type === 'receipt') {
            $customer = Customer::find($payment->customer_id);
            if ($customer) {
                $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance + $amount;
                $customer->save();
            }
        } elseif ($payment->customer_id && $payment->type === 'payment') {
            $customer = Customer::find($payment->customer_id);
            if ($customer) {
                $customer->current_balance = (float) $customer->current_balance - $amount;
                $customer->save();
            }
        } elseif ($payment->supplier_id && $payment->type === 'payment') {
            $supplier = Supplier::find($payment->supplier_id);
            if ($supplier) {
                $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance + $amount;
                $supplier->save();
            }
        } elseif ($payment->supplier_id && $payment->type === 'receipt') {
            $supplier = Supplier::find($payment->supplier_id);
            if ($supplier) {
                $supplier->current_balance = (float) $supplier->current_balance - $amount;
                $supplier->save();
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * إنشاء القيد المحاسبي للسند
     */
    protected function postJournalEntry(Payment $payment): void
    {
        try {
            // منع التكرار
            if (JournalEntry::where('ref_type', 'payment')->where('ref_id', $payment->id)->exists()) {
                return;
            }

            $accountingService = app(\App\Services\PaymentAccountingService::class);
            $accountingService->postPayment($payment);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::warning('Payment journal entry failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}
PHPCODE;

file_put_contents($base . '/app/Observers/PaymentObserver.php', $paymentObserverCode);
echo "✅ PaymentObserver (المكان الوحيد للتحديث)\n";

// ============================================
// 4. إصلاح البيانات الحالية المتضررة
// ============================================
echo "\n📋 المرحلة 3: إصلاح البيانات المتضررة...\n";

$fixedCount = 0;

$invoices = Invoice::whereIn('type', ['sale', 'purchase', 'sale_return', 'purchase_return'])->get();

foreach ($invoices as $invoice) {
    // حساب المدفوع الفعلي من السندات
    $actualPaid = (float) Payment::where('invoice_id', $invoice->id)->sum('amount');
    $currentPaid = (float) $invoice->paid_amount;

    if (abs($currentPaid - $actualPaid) > 0.01) {
        $oldPaid = $currentPaid;
        $invoice->paid_amount = $actualPaid;
        $invoice->remaining_amount = max(0, (float) $invoice->total - $actualPaid);
        $invoice->saveQuietly();

        $fixedCount++;
        echo "   🔧 {$invoice->invoice_no}: paid {$oldPaid} → {$actualPaid}\n";
    }
}

if ($fixedCount === 0) {
    echo "   ✅ لا توجد فواتير تحتاج إصلاح\n";
} else {
    echo "   ✅ تم إصلاح {$fixedCount} فاتورة\n";
}

// إصلاح أرصدة العملاء
echo "\n📋 المرحلة 4: إعادة حساب أرصدة العملاء...\n";

$customers = Customer::all();
foreach ($customers as $customer) {
    $oldBalance = (float) $customer->current_balance;

    // الرصيد = الافتتاحي + فواتير البيع - مرتجعات البيع - سندات القبض + سندات الصرف
    $opening = (float) ($customer->opening_balance ?? 0);
    $sales = (float) Invoice::where('customer_id', $customer->id)->where('type', 'sale')->sum('total');
    $saleReturns = (float) Invoice::where('customer_id', $customer->id)->where('type', 'sale_return')->sum('total');
    $receipts = (float) Payment::where('customer_id', $customer->id)->where('type', 'receipt')->sum('amount');
    $refunds = (float) Payment::where('customer_id', $customer->id)->where('type', 'payment')->sum('amount');

    $newBalance = $opening + $sales - $saleReturns - $receipts + $refunds;

    if (abs($oldBalance - $newBalance) > 0.01) {
        $customer->current_balance = $newBalance;
        $customer->save();
        echo "   🔧 {$customer->name}: {$oldBalance} → {$newBalance}\n";
    }
}

// إصلاح أرصدة الموردين
echo "\n📋 المرحلة 5: إعادة حساب أرصدة الموردين...\n";

$suppliers = Supplier::all();
foreach ($suppliers as $supplier) {
    $oldBalance = (float) $supplier->current_balance;

    $opening = (float) ($supplier->opening_balance ?? 0);
    $purchases = (float) Invoice::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)->where('type', 'purchase')->sum('total');
    $purchaseReturns = (float) Invoice::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)->where('type', 'purchase_return')->sum('total');
    $paymentsToSupplier = (float) Payment::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)->where('type', 'payment')->sum('amount');
    $receiptsFromSupplier = (float) Payment::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)->where('type', 'receipt')->sum('amount');

    $newBalance = $opening + $purchases - $purchaseReturns - $paymentsToSupplier + $receiptsFromSupplier;

    if (abs($oldBalance - $newBalance) > 0.01) {
        $supplier->current_balance = $newBalance;
        $supplier->save();
        echo "   🔧 {$supplier->name}: {$oldBalance} → {$newBalance}\n";
    }
}

// ============================================
// 5. التحقق من الـ syntax
// ============================================
echo "\n📋 التحقق من الـ syntax...\n";

$filesToCheck = [
    'app/Services/InvoiceService.php',
    'app/Observers/PaymentObserver.php',
];

$allGood = true;
foreach ($filesToCheck as $file) {
    $output = [];
    $returnCode = 0;
    exec('php -l "' . $base . '/' . $file . '" 2>&1', $output, $returnCode);

    if ($returnCode === 0) {
        echo "   ✅ {$file}\n";
    } else {
        echo "   ❌ {$file}: " . implode("\n", $output) . "\n";
        $allGood = false;
    }
}

// ============================================
// 6. مسح الكاش
// ============================================
echo "\n🔄 مسح الكاش...\n";
passthru('php artisan optimize:clear 2>&1');

echo "\n" . str_repeat('=', 70) . "\n";
echo "✅ تم إصلاح مشكلة مضاعفة المدفوع بنجاح!\n";
echo str_repeat('=', 70) . "\n\n";

echo "🎯 السبب الجذري:\n";
echo "   paid_amount كان يُحدَّث في 3 أماكن:\n";
echo "   ❌ 1. InvoiceService: يضبط paid_amount مباشرة\n";
echo "   ❌ 2. PaymentObserver: يزيد paid_amount مرة أخرى\n";
echo "   ❌ 3. InvoiceObserver: يُطلق عند update مما قد يسبب تكرار\n\n";

echo "🔧 الحل:\n";
echo "   ✅ InvoiceService: يُنشئ الفاتورة بـ paid_amount = 0 ثم يُنشئ السند\n";
echo "   ✅ PaymentObserver: المكان الوحيد الذي يُحدّث:\n";
echo "      • invoice.paid_amount\n";
echo "      • customer/supplier.current_balance\n";
echo "      • القيد المحاسبي\n";
echo "   ✅ saveQuietly(): يمنع InvoiceObserver من التكرار\n\n";

echo "📊 البيانات المصلحة:\n";
echo "   • الفواتير: {$fixedCount} فاتورة تم إصلاح paid_amount\n";
echo "   • أرصدة العملاء: أُعيد حسابها\n";
echo "   • أرصدة الموردين: أُعيد حسابها\n\n";

echo "🧪 اختبر الآن:\n";
echo "   1. أنشئ فاتورة شراء بـ 500 وادفع 500\n";
echo "   2. تحقق أن المدفوع = 500 (وليس 1500)\n";
echo "   3. افتح /purchases لترى القائمة\n";
echo "   4. افتح كشف حساب المورد للتأكد\n";
```

## 🎯 شرح المشكلة والحل

### ❌ قبل الإصلاح (3 أماكن تحدّث `paid_amount`):

```
InvoiceService::createPurchase()
│
├─ $invoice->update(['paid_amount' => 1000])     ← المرة الأولى ✅
│
├─ $supplier->current_balance -= 1000            ← المرة الأولى ✅
│
└─ Payment::create(amount: 1000)
   │
   └─ PaymentObserver::created()
      │
      ├─ updateInvoicePaidAmount()
      │  └─ $invoice->paid_amount += 1000        ← المرة الثانية ❌ (أصبح 2000)
      │     │
      │     └─ $invoice->save()
      │        │
      │        └─ InvoiceObserver::updated()      ← المرة الثالثة ❌ (قد يزيد)
      │
      └─ updatePartyBalance()
         └─ $supplier->current_balance -= 1000    ← تكرار! ❌
```

### ✅ بعد الإصلاح (مكان واحد فقط):

```
InvoiceService::createPurchase()
│
├─ $invoice->update(['paid_amount' => 0])         ← يبدأ من صفر
│
├─ $supplier->current_balance += total             ← الفاتورة فقط (بدون الدفع)
│
└─ Payment::create(amount: 1000)
   │
   └─ PaymentObserver::created()                   ← المكان الوحيد
      │
      ├─ updateInvoicePaidAmount()
      │  └─ $invoice->paid_amount += 1000          ← مرة واحدة فقط ✅
      │     └─ $invoice->saveQuietly()             ← لا يُطلق InvoiceObserver ✅
      │
      ├─ updatePartyBalance()
      │  └─ $supplier->current_balance -= 1000     ← مرة واحدة فقط ✅
      │
      └─ postJournalEntry()
         └─ القيد المحاسبي                         ← مرة واحدة فقط ✅
```

### ASSISTANT
هذا **ليس تشفيراً** (Encryption)، بل هو ما يُسمى **JSON Unicode Escaping** (ترميز يونيكود في JSON). 

السبب أن دالة `json_encode()` في PHP تقوم افتراضياً بتحويل الأحرف العربية والرموز الخاصة إلى صيغة `\uXXXX` لضمان توافقها مع جميع أنظمة قواعد البيانات القديمة التي لا تدعم UTF-8 بشكل كامل.

الحل بسيط جداً: نحتاج لإضافة خيار `JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE` لدالة `json_encode` في مكان تسجيل الـ Log (غالباً في `AuditObserver`).

إليك الحل الشامل لإصلاح هذا الأمر:

### 🚀 ملف الإصلاح التلقائي

```bash
cd C:\laragon\www\sales-accounting
type nul > fix_audit_encoding.php
notepad fix_audit_encoding.php
```

```php
<?php
echo "🔧 إصلاح ترميز اللغة العربية في سجل العمليات (Audit Log)...\n\n";

$base = __DIR__;
require $base . '/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require_once $base . '/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make('Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel')->bootstrap();

// ============================================
// 1. البحث عن ملف AuditObserver وإصلاحه
// ============================================
echo "📋 المرحلة 1: البحث عن AuditObserver وإصلاح json_encode...\n";

$observerPath = $base . '/app/Observers/AuditObserver.php';

if (file_exists($observerPath)) {
    $content = file_get_contents($observerPath);
    
    // البحث عن أي استدعاء لـ json_encode بدون flags
    if (strpos($content, 'JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE') === false) {
        // استبدال json_encode($variable) بـ json_encode($variable, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)
        // هذا يحافظ على الأحرف العربية والـ slashes كما هي
        
        $content = preg_replace(
            '/json_encode\(\s*(\$[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\)/',
            'json_encode($1, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)',
            $content
        );
        
        // حالة خاصة: إذا كان هناك flags موجودة بالفعل، نضيف لها UNESCAPED
        $content = preg_replace(
            '/json_encode\(\s*(\$[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*,\s*([^\)]+)\)/',
            'json_encode($1, $2 | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)',
            $content
        );

        file_put_contents($observerPath, $content);
        echo "✅ تم إصلاح AuditObserver.php لدعم اللغة العربية بشكل مقروء\n";
    } else {
        echo "ℹ️  AuditObserver.php يدعم اللغة العربية بالفعل\n";
    }
} else {
    echo "⚠️  لم يتم العثور على AuditObserver.php. جاري البحث في ملفات الـ Observers الأخرى...\n";
    
    $observersDir = $base . '/app/Observers';
    if (is_dir($observersDir)) {
        $files = glob($observersDir . '/*.php');
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $content = file_get_contents($file);
            if (strpos($content, 'json_encode') !== false && strpos($content, 'JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE') === false) {
                $content = preg_replace(
                    '/json_encode\(\s*(\$[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\)/',
                    'json_encode($1, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)',
                    $content
                );
                file_put_contents($file, $content);
                echo "✅ تم إصلاح: " . basename($file) . "\n";
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================
// 2. التحقق من Custom Logger (إذا كان موجوداً)
// ============================================
echo "\n📋 المرحلة 2: التحقق من خدمات التسجيل المخصصة...\n";

$servicesDir = $base . '/app/Services';
if (is_dir($servicesDir)) {
    $files = glob($servicesDir . '/*Log*.php'); // البحث عن أي ملف يحتوي على Log في اسمه
    foreach ($files as $file) {
        $content = file_get_contents($file);
        if (strpos($content, 'json_encode') !== false && strpos($content, 'JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE') === false) {
            $content = preg_replace(
                '/json_encode\(\s*(\$[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\)/',
                'json_encode($1, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)',
                $content
            );
            file_put_contents($file, $content);
            echo "✅ تم إصلاح: " . basename($file) . "\n";
        }
    }
}

// ============================================
// 3. فحص الـ Casts في موديل Audit (إن وجد)
// ============================================
echo "\n📋 المرحلة 3: فحص Casting في الموديلات...\n";

$auditModelPath = $base . '/app/Models/Audit.php'; // أو الاسم المستخدم لديك
if (file_exists($auditModelPath)) {
    $content = file_get_contents($auditModelPath);
    if (strpos($content, "'old_values' => 'json'") !== false || strpos($content, "'new_values' => 'json'") !== false) {
        echo "✅ موديل Audit يستخدم 'json' cast، مما يعني أن واجهة العرض (Blade) ستظهر النص العربي بشكل صحيح تلقائياً.\n";
    }
}

// ============================================
// 4. مسح الكاش
// ============================================
echo "\n🔄 مسح الكاش...\n";
passthru('php artisan optimize:clear 2>&1');

// ============================================
// 5. اختبار فك الترميز
// ============================================
echo "\n🧪 اختبار فك الترميز:\n";
$encodedString = '\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0647\u0645\u0629 \u0631\u0623\u0633 \u0645\u0627\u0644 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u0631\u064a\u0643 \u0645\u062d\u0645\u062f \u062e\u064a\u0631\u064a';
$decodedString = json_decode('"' . $encodedString . '"');
echo "   النص المشفر: {$encodedString}\n";
echo "   النص بعد الفك: {$decodedString}\n";

echo "\n" . str_repeat('=', 70) . "\n";
echo "✅ تم إصلاح ترميز اللغة العربية في سجل العمليات!\n";
echo str_repeat('=', 70) . "\n\n";

echo "🎯 ما تم إصلاحه:\n";
echo "   • إضافة JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES\n";
echo "   • هذا يضمن حفظ النص العربي في قاعدة البيانات كما هو (بدون \uXXXX)\n\n";

echo "💡 ملاحظات هامة:\n";
echo "   1. السجلات القديمة في قاعدة البيانات ستبقى مشفرة (هذا طبيعي ولا يؤثر على العرض).\n";
echo "   2. إذا كنت تستخدم Laravel Blade لعرض السجل، فبفضل الـ 'json' cast، سيظهر النص العربي صحيحاً تلقائياً حتى لو كان مشفراً في قاعدة البيانات.\n";
echo "   3. السجلات الجديدة从现在开始 ستظهر باللغة العربية المقروءة مباشرة في قاعدة البيانات.\n\n";

echo "🧪 جرب الآن:\n";
echo "   • قم بإضافة عملية جديدة (مثل إضافة سند أو فاتورة).\n";
echo "   • اذهب لسجل العمليات وتحقق من أن حقل 'notes' أو البيانات يظهر بالعربية الواضحة.\n";
```

---

### 🔍 لماذا يحدث هذا؟ (شرح تقني مبسط)

عندما يقوم Laravel أو الكود المخصص بحفظ البيانات في عمود من نوع `JSON` أو `TEXT`، يتم استخدام دالة `json_encode()`.
السلوك الافتراضي لـ PHP هو:
```php
$data = ['notes' => 'مساهمة رأس مال'];
echo json_encode($data); 
// الناتج: {"notes":"\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0647\u0645\u0629 \u0631\u0623\u0633 \u0645\u0627\u0644"}
```

عند إضافة الـ Flags:
```php
echo json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
// الناتج: {"notes":"مساهمة رأس مال"}
```

---

### 💡 هل يؤثر هذا على عرض البيانات في الموقع؟

**لا، غالباً لا يؤثر.** 
إذا كان موديل الـ Audit (أو الـ Log) يحتوي على هذا الكود:
```php
protected $casts = [
    'new_values' => 'json',
    'old_values' => 'json',
];
```
فإن Laravel يقوم **تلقائياً** بفك هذا الترميز (`json_decode`) عند عرض البيانات في واجهة المستخدم (Blade). لذلك، قد تراه مشفراً فقط عندما تنظر مباشرة إلى قاعدة البيانات (مثل phpMyAdmin أو جدول الـ logs الخام)، لكنه سيظهر بشكل عربي سليم في صفحة "سجل العمليات" داخل النظام.

الإصلاح الذي قمنا به الآن يضمن أنه سيظهر مقروءاً **حتى داخل قاعدة البيانات** لتسهيل التدقيق اليدوي.
